enemies.special: None. It is the tutorial enemy: the first battle ever is a single rabbit.

enemies.sample_shout_en: to look; to watch; to read
enemies.special: Quick Start: in round 1 it attacks before the hero’s first turn.
Coin Grab: once per battle a broken block also steals 3 gold; it drops all of it back when defeated.
Big Huff: every 3rd turn it puffs its cheeks the turn before (telegraph); if you break that block you take +2 damage.
Royal Call: the first time he drops below 50% HP (the save checkpoint) he calls 1 horned rabbit if fewer than 3 enemies are on screen.
None.
Root Trip: a broken block roots the hero, so Flee is unavailable on the next turn.
Sticky Web: after a broken block the hero is webbed and their next attack deals half damage.
Wax Shield: its wax shield absorbs the hero’s first hit of the battle (that hit deals only 1).

enemies.minions: 1 Giant Bee (chasing the bear, but angry at everyone)
enemies.special: Snack Break: once, the first time it drops below 50% HP, it licks honey from its paw and heals 8 HP.

Summon Worker (v3): every 3 turns she summons 1 small worker bee (half normal HP, no gold, EXP or chest) if fewer than 3 enemies are on screen, max 2 summons per fight. Defeating her makes all bees fly home (the battle ends).
None.
Color Shout: its bark always names its current color (red, blue, yellow or green variant).
Surprise: it acts first in round 1. Its chest chance is higher (25%, elite rule).
Pay Up!: every 3rd turn he taps his club the turn before (telegraph); a broken block on that attack takes +3 damage.
Lid Shut: every 3rd turn it shuts its lid; the hero’s next attack deals half damage unless the answer is spoken.
None.
None.

enemies.sample_shout_en: to start class; to attend class
enemies.special: Roll Call: once per battle, if it is the last enemy standing, it rings its bell and 1 goblin joins.
Big Swing: every 3rd turn it lifts the desk (telegraph); a broken block on that attack takes +3 damage.
Echo: every 3rd turn its defense question re-asks the last item the kid missed this battle (if any), same way.
Drops the School Gate Key (story item) that opens L4.3.
School Bell: the first time he drops below 50% HP (checkpoint) he rings the bell and 1 goblin rejoins if fewer than 3 enemies. When defeated, the kids and the teacher are freed and cheer 谢谢!
Muddy: a broken block makes the hero muddy, so their next attack deals 2 less damage.
None.
Glow Drain: a broken block also drains 3 MP.
Pocket Grab: every 3rd turn its tongue grabs your potion bag, so potions can’t be used on the hero’s next turn.
Double Bite: every 3rd turn two heads attack (two defense questions, each blocked separately). Every 25% HP lost, one head gets tired and ducks under the water (visual only).
Cure: at 0 HP it isn’t destroyed; a puff of sparkly green mist clears and it turns back into a villager who says 谢谢! (same drops).
None.
Shield Up: every 3rd turn it raises its shield, halving the hero’s damage that round. It is cured at 0 HP like other zombies.
Cure at 0 HP. When cured he gives the Village Key and tells you where the sickness came from.
Germ Call: every 3 turns it calls 1 zombie if fewer than 3 enemies are on screen. Defeating it cures every zombie on screen at once.
None.
None.
Straight Line: it only walks straight; if the hero blocked its last attack, it bumps into a rock and skips its next turn.

Respect: every 3rd turn it uses Gale Breath; if the hero blocks it, the dragon is impressed and skips its next attack. When defeated it bows and lets you pass (it can become an ally later in the story).
Royal Dive: every 3rd turn he circles up (telegraph) and dives; a broken block on that attack takes +50%. Defeating him breaks the storm crown and frees all griffins.
Regrow (cosmetic): green sparkles and a taunt when a round passes without it being hit; no healing.
None.
Toasty: a broken block leaves the hero toasty, losing 3 HP at the end of the next round.
Charge: every 3rd turn it scrapes its hoof (telegraph); a broken block on that attack takes +50%.
Show-off: every 3rd turn he poses for the crowd instead of attacking; the hero’s next correct attack deals +50%.
None.
Dark Guard: the hero’s first hit on it each battle deals half damage.
Stone Sleep: it starts as a statue and wakes when hit or at the end of round 2, whichever comes first.
Curse Chain: while the imp is up, the dragon’s ATK is +3. Defeating the dragon breaks the curse: it turns golden, says 谢谢 and becomes an ally in the final battle story.
Two phases: at 50% HP (checkpoint) his cape turns red and he calls up to 2 demon knights (max 3 on screen). Every 4th turn he charges Rule by Force (telegraph); a broken block on it takes +50%.

spells.visual_brief: A plum-sized orange fireball with a curly tail of sparks, thrown from the wand tip. On hit: a warm puff of orange light and a few floating embers. No scorch marks, nothing burns.

spells.status: Soaked: the target's next attack does half damage
spells.visual_brief: A stream of shiny rainbow soap bubbles that wraps the enemy in a big wobbly bubble for a moment; when it pops the enemy is dripping and grumpy, with a little water cloud over its head.
Fluffy snowballs pop out of the air and pelt every enemy of the chosen kind; soft white bursts and a sprinkle of snowflakes. Enemies shiver comically.

spells.status: Dazed: 25% chance the target skips its next attack (bosses 12.5%)
spells.visual_brief: A small zig-zag bolt from a palm-sized storm cloud; yellow flash, the target's fur/hair stands up and little stars circle its head when dazed.
A melon-sized fireball with a bright yellow core and a spiral trail; a round orange flash and a ring of sparks on impact.
A green-white spinning gust with leaves in it that lifts every enemy of the chosen kind, spins them like tops and drops them dizzy.
Big sparkling snowflakes swirl across the whole screen and tap each enemy (max 3) with a soft chime; frost glitter on their shoulders.

spells.status: Dazed: 30% chance the target skips its next attack (bosses 15%)
spells.visual_brief: A tall bright bolt from a dark-blue cloud; screen flashes white for a frame (keep under the flash-safety limit), target gets spiky hair and circling stars.
Golden sunbeams break through grey clouds onto every enemy of the chosen kind; zombies/skeletons sneeze and look a bit more cheerful (ties to the "cured by kind words" theme).
A big round fireball with a smiling glow that grows above the hero before it is thrown; big orange burst with confetti-like sparks.

spells.status: Chilled: each target 30% chance to skip its next attack (bosses 15%)
spells.hsk_chars: 暴 (暴风雨, 6) · 风 1 · 雪 2 · 术 (技术, 3)
spells.visual_brief: A sideways snowstorm sweeps over all enemies (max 3); they get snow hats and icicle eyebrows when chilled. Blue-white palette, soft wind sound.
A tall friendly-looking tornado (with leaves, feathers and a lost hat) gathers every enemy of the chosen kind, spins them up and plops them down.
A shooting star with a long rainbow tail falls on one enemy; a starburst flash and tiny stars bouncing off. No crater.

spells.status: Dazed: each target 30% chance to skip its next attack (bosses 15%)
spells.visual_brief: A small storm cloud rains on all enemies (max 3) with friendly zig-zag bolts; puddles form under them and they hop around.

spells.status: Frozen: every non-boss target skips its next attack (1 turn); bosses are immune

The sky turns deep violet and a shower of colourful shooting stars rains on all enemies (max 3); each hit makes a star-shaped sparkle.
